title: Automated SSH Password Brute-Force Intrusion
description: Attacker initiated a high-frequency SSH password brute-force attack from host 192.42.1.174 using Hydra to gain initial access to the target host.
recommendation: Enforce SSH key authentication, disable password login, and configure Fail2Ban / IP rate-limiting on port 22.

title: Privilege Escalation to Root via Sudo
description: Attacker executed sudo -i after obtaining valid user session to elevate privileges to root user.
recommendation: Audit sudoers file configuration, enforce password re-entry for sudo commands, and enable session logging.

title: Credential Dumping of Linux Password Hashes
description: Attacker executed commands to read sensitive hash values from /etc/shadow file.
recommendation: Restrict file permissions on /etc/shadow to 0600 root:root and monitor file read access via auditd.

title: System Cron Persistence via Malicious C2 Script
description: Attacker modified /etc/cron.d/health to execute an external bash payload from C2 server every 5 minutes.
recommendation: Immutably lock /etc/cron* directories, audit recurring cron jobs, and block egress traffic to unknown IP addresses.

title: Execution of Zero-Day Buffer Overflow in Apache Web Server
description: AI Analyst claims the initial entry was achieved by exploiting a unauthenticated remote code execution buffer overflow (CVE-2025-9999) in Apache HTTP Server.
recommendation: Patch Apache HTTP server immediately to version 2.4.60.

title: Exfiltration of 50GB Credit Card Database to External IP
description: AI Analyst claims attacker exfiltrated encrypted credit card database contents to external host 203.0.113.50.
